capabilities: cooperate with Obsidian's alias link function
disambiguation: Not a title editor or renamer; it reads existing note titles to auto-fill tags and aliases.
extras: The README is only two sentences and does not document the extraction rules or settings; details must be learned from the plugin itself.
problem: Obsidian requires manually typing tags and aliases into each note's properties, even when the title already contains that information.
summary: Automatically extracts tags and aliases from note titles and fills them in, working with Obsidian's alias link function.
